2363-4659-5224-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
2363-4659-5224-7693.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Armor Wars, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-2457-7824-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7233-8095.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value X or greater.
6972-7233-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-6823.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

628-5256-7865.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

1018-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Skullwinder.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Skullwinder from exile to the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Flesh Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3532-5078-5957-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3490-3755-7075-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-7075-7730.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1765-2440-4758-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
1765-2440-4758-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

277-774-4543.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}.
277-774-4543.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trench Behemoth twice by returning two lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

527-1753-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-3446-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1796-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
1796-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

4871-6010-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the persist creature trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1479-5700-5701-6754-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6754-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

969-1350-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
969-1350-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4871-5258-5618-6131.description:
Cast Ignot Chewer for its evoke cost by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Ingot Chewer enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, destroying target artifact.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to sacrifice Ingot Chewer.
When Ingot Chewer dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Ingot Chewer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger from step 6, causing you to exile the top five cards of your library, including Ingot Chewer, with the ability to play those cards until end of turn.
Cast Ingot Chewer from exile for its evoke cost by paying {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

575-1207-2292.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2292-2896-5145.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

372-1734-2885-4605.description:
Cast Rescue the Foal by paying {1}{W}, blinking Fiend Hunter and exiling Rescue the Foal.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter until the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
When the nontoken Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Abdel Adrian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the token Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Abdel Adrian's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, choose not to exile a permanent.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the token Fiend Hunter and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

780-813-2292-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Scholar of the Ages.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages dies, it triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Supernatural Stamina and Dark Ritual to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

771-1378-2239-4886.notablePrerequisites:
Wildfire Eternal does not have summoning sickness.
Mirage Phalanx is paired with Ardent Elementalist.
An opponent cannot block Wildfire Eternal.
771-1378-2239-4886.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mirage Phalanx and Ardent Elementalist each trigger, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist and Mirage Phalanx with haste and without soulbond.
When the token Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Savage Beating to your hand from your graveyard.
Declare Wildfire Eternal as an attacker.
When Wildfire Eternal is not blocked, it triggers, casting Savage Beating from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Savage Beating, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, the Mirage Phalanx and Ardent Elementalist tokens trigger, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.

141-3130.manaNeeded: {7}{U}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-3130.easyPrerequisites: There is a creature on the battlefield.
141-3130.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting a creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2178-3343-3490-4871.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B} plus an additional {1} for each other creature you control
2034-2178-3343-3490-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Aron.
Aron does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures.
2034-2178-3343-3490-4871.description:
Activate Aron by paying {W}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
The creature dies, triggering Aron and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Aron trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Aron ability from step 1, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
The Servo dies, triggering Aron and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Aron trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 10 through 13 until you only control one Servo.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{B}.
Repeat.

687-4050-4626.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
687-4050-4626.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding {1}.
Promise of Bunrei triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and create four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that enter the battlefield with vigilance counters on them.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three vigilance counters from the Spirits, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Promise of Bunrei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-2665-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Archaeomancer.
2493-2665-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

644-1267-3632-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites: Triton Shorestalker does not have summoning sickness.
644-1267-3632-4600-5241.description:
Attack with Triton Shorestalker and when it isn't blocked, cast Sakashima's Student's for it's ninjutsu cost, paying {1}{U} and returning Triton Shorestalker to hand.
Have Sakashima's Student enter the battlefield as a copy of Medomai the Ageless and deal combat damage, gaining you an extra turn.
During your second main phase, cast Triton Shorestalker for {U}.
Return Sakashima's Student to your hand with Erratic Portal for {1}.
Pass the turn to yourself and repeat.

914-5105-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5105-5147.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
